presentation.label: TRACK SOLO
presentation.summary: Momentary solo: hold a track for two seconds, tap others to join, then release to restore.
presentation.overview: A session-only audition while editing. The held anchor is hidden from stock shortcuts; underlying mute and solo changes apply when the audition ends.
highlights: Two-second hold with one anchor track.
Toggle other audio tracks into the group with one press.
Release the anchor to return to the underlying mute and solo state.
usage: Open PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER and set TRACK SOLO to HOLD.
Hold T2 alone for two seconds, then press T3 to add or remove it.
Release T2 to end the temporary solo.

limitations: Private emulator prototype; physical MKII/MKI, CPU timing and USB lifecycle qualification remain pending. See TESTING.md for exact-build evidence.
TRACK SOLO is OFF on startup and after package replacement; its enable setting and solo groups are not saved.
MIDI mode is excluded. When T8 is master, include it with the source tracks in the temporary group; T8 alone has no source audio.
Mute Modes is optional. Its policy governs tails and trig suppression. Focused emulator tests cover four policies on the corrected private base; hardware remains untested.
USB settings use the existing shared row table; native card settings integration is pending.

storage.label: Storage
storage.conditions: Revised UX private build 11: 1500-byte initialized image, zero BSS, 24 relocations, seven guarded sites and 2128-byte package. No DSP allocation. Excludes base bookkeeping and unmeasured native stack.

access.location: PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER > TRACK SOLO (USB runtime prototype)
steps: Install the private Track Solo runtime package in an emulator.
Open PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER and choose HOLD for TRACK SOLO.
Close the menu, hold one TRACK button alone for two seconds, then tap others to toggle their solo.
Release the original TRACK button to end solo; choose OFF to disable the gesture.
